rationale: Best-disclosing UA non-bank PSP: audited group statements and licences on a stable disclosure page; failed verification is soft only.
Live IR surface with recurring bond prospectuses and issuer reports carrying otherwise-unpublished PSP financials.
Static corporate about-page of portmone.com.ua; covered by monitoring the company domain/blog rather than standalone.
De facto press room of a market-leading UA PSP; recurring product and partnership signals, failed check is soft.
Legal/licence disclosures naming the operating entity and NBU licence numbers; changes when licensing changes.
Registry aggregator with the practical route to private-PSP financials, but dossiers are largely behind registration/paywall.
Second register aggregator with API and change alerts on PSP entities; strong cross-check on YouControl.
Official bulk open dataset of annual financial statements by EDRPOU; free, licensed, refreshed per reporting year.
Payments industry association publishing recurring market-news digests plus a member list that maps the actor set.
Dedicated UA fintech/payments trade press; frequent volume and market-structure reporting on private PSPs.
Financial-sector news hub with regulatory depth on non-bank payment institutions.
Valuable ownership investigations of payment groups but general-business homepage with likely metered access; confirm reachability.
Sustained investigative coverage of the LEO/IBox payment entity web that no register presents in one place.
Wire economic feed with dated, quotable PSP bond, licensing and oversight items; failed check is soft only.
Single issuer securities page on minfin.com.ua; monitor the portal's securities section rather than this leaf.
One-off law-firm PDF briefing on the payment services law; useful orientation evidence, not a recurring feed.
Single bar-association commentary post; glossary value only, no ongoing payments signal.
Single accountancy-blog explainer of low credibility; marginal against regulator primary sources.
NBU payments hub: authoritative registries, oversight material and card/POS statistics for the whole sector.
Annual oversight report series is the richest structured dataset on schemes, processors and infrastructure; monitor the series URL pattern.
Domestic card scheme's own site: participant lists and acceptance-network news, plus a pointer to member banks and processors.
Regulator designation listing systemically important processors; mine for the actor map, refresh when reissued annually.
Recurring NBU market-trends deck with card, POS and volume series between full reports.
Quarterly official payments digest with new PROSTIR participants — highest-frequency scheme membership signal.
NBU annual report payments chapter; slower cadence cross-check on the oversight series.
Largest non-bank card processor, NBU-designated important infrastructure; site carries client wins and product launches.
Major processing centre and ATM network operator disclosing acceptance-infrastructure detail; failed check is soft only.
